text: Because of the special nature of the offspring of the science of the “ālaya” (storehouse), all are capable; thus, in that respect, the passage of time is established. Moreover, at some point, for the purpose of living, the six objects of sense—sound, touch, form, taste, odor, and the objects of pleasure—arise together with the four afflictions (the six sense objects and the four mental afflictions). By means of the four, one should cover one’s own experience with the desire to be free from suffering.
